title: Privacy & cookies
html:
Privacy & cookies

Updated October 3, 2026

Scope

This notice describes the current CREATACANVAS website. It will need updating when the publisher adds contact details or changes the site’s data practices.

Saved posts and likes

The journal stores your saved article identifiers and likes in local storage on the browser you use. These preferences are not sent by the journal code to a publisher database and do not sync between devices. Clear them using the control on this page or by clearing this site’s browser data.

Hosting and access

The site is hosted through ChatGPT Sites. The hosting platform may process request information such as IP addresses and browser details to deliver, secure, and operate the website. Access to the current private publication is managed by the platform. Its own privacy terms also apply; see OpenAI’s privacy policy.

Advertising and analytics

No Google AdSense code, publisher analytics, advertising cookies, or contact submission form has been installed in this version. We therefore do not claim that Google advertising is currently active.

If Google advertising is introduced

Third-party advertising providers, including Google, may use cookies to select ads using previous visits to this and other websites. Google and its partners may use advertising cookies for personalization. You can manage personalized Google ads through My Ad Center and find information about participating providers at AboutAds choices. Before advertising is enabled, this notice must identify the services actually used, and the publisher must implement the applicable consent controls.

Contact and changes

The publisher has not yet provided a public privacy contact. This notice will be updated with that contact before an advertising application. Changes to data collection should be described here before the relevant feature is introduced.
